CODE_DEFINITION: Recommended age to represent the midden sample/assemblage.
Recommended age to represent the midden sample/assemblage but use with caution.
Pooled Age (PA) generated by CALIB (rev. 7.0.4).  The primary preferred age of the midden sample/assemblage when there are multiple ages on a sample within 2 standard deviations of each other.

Pooled Age (Failed Significance Test) generated by CALIB (rev. 7.0.4).  The primary preferred age of the midden sample/assemblage when there are multiple ages on a sample within 2 standard deviations of each other, but CALIB considers the ages not to be statistically the same.
Secondary preferred age when there are multiple ages on a sample, represented by the age with the smaller standard deviation.
Multiple ages are not within two standard deviations of each other and it is uncertain which age represents the midden sample/assemblage.
